name: Elbeflohmarkt

rhythm.de: Jeden Samstag, Ende Januar bis Ende November
rhythm.en: Every Saturday, late January to late November

facts: on the Elbe bank below the Albertbrücke
antiques, rarities, household goods, second-hand clothes, collectibles, GDR-era items
free parking across the river at Wigardstraße
food stands and toilets on site
notes: Organiser lists every Saturday to 2026-11-28, then a winter pause; 2026 season began 31 January, 2027 start not yet published. Coordinates are the ones the organiser prints on the page. Old domain elbeflohmarkt-dresden.de redirects here. Stand fee 20 EUR for 1–2 m (sellers, not visitors).

description.de: Jeden Samstag von Ende Januar bis Ende November am Elbufer unterhalb der Albertbrücke. Händler und private Verkäufer bieten Antiquitäten, Raritäten, Haushaltswaren, Second-Hand-Kleidung und Dinge aus DDR-Zeiten. Eintritt frei; Tram 6 und 13 halten am Güntzplatz, kostenlose Parkplätze gegenüber an der Wigardstraße.
description.en: Every Saturday from late January to late November on the Elbe bank below the Albertbrücke. Dealers and private sellers bring antiques, rarities, household goods, second-hand clothes and GDR-era pieces. Entry is free; trams 6 and 13 stop at Güntzplatz, and there is free parking across the river on Wigardstraße.
